bio: Delight in a traditional afternoon tea aboard the Dorset Queen. Enjoy bottomless prosecco as you explore the magnificent coastline.  Set sail and enjoy a unique British experience with a cruise aboard the Dorset Queen. Departing from the historic Poole Quay, you'll enjoy a voyage towards the coastline of Lilliput, passing Parkstone Yacht Club and Salterns Marina as well as the Royal Motor Yacht Club. Enjoy incredible passing views of the 16th Century Brownsea Castle and travel on to the impressive Millionaires Row of Sandbanks. A delicious afternoon tea will be served during the trip, allowing you to enjoy some scrumptious nibbles while you cruise.
